why_the_named_schema_cannot_carry_this_a: It is an Issue *closure* contract. It requires `disposition` from {DIRECTLY_LANDED, CONSUMED_BY_CONVERGENCE, SCOPE_TRANSFERRED, SUPERSEDED, NOT_PLANNED}; #535 is OPEN, nothing landed, nothing was transferred or superseded, and it is not NOT_PLANNED. Every admissible value is a false statement about this issue.

It requires `issue.github_state_reason` from {COMPLETED, NOT_PLANNED, REOPENED}. #535 is OPEN. There is no truthful value, and writing COMPLETED to satisfy the enum is exactly the evidence promotion this review exists to refuse.

It is `additionalProperties: false` and has no field for reviewed-subject digests, per-stage findings, first-red preservation, falsifier outcomes, Builder-assertion→evidence mapping, or evidence ceilings — every one of which #535's Output section mandates.
